name: RLS disabled
mutate: alter table sefirot.chat_bridge_jobs disable row level security

name: service direct access
mutate: grant select on sefirot.chat_bridge_jobs to service_role

name: service private schema usage
mutate: grant usage on schema sefirot to service_role

name: public claim access
mutate: grant execute on function public.sefirot_chat_claim() to anon

name: unknown completion body
mutate: create or replace function public.sefirot_chat_complete(p_id uuid,p_success boolean,p_response jsonb,p_error text) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$ begin return '{}'::jsonb;end $$

name: backup body drift
mutate: create or replace function sefirot.chat_complete_before_probe_fence(p_id uuid,p_success boolean,p_response jsonb,p_error text) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$ begin return '{}'::jsonb;end $$

name: probe RPC body drift
mutate: create or replace function public.sefirot_probe_complete(p_id uuid,p_attempt integer,p_success boolean,p_response jsonb,p_error text) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$ begin return '{}'::jsonb;end $$

name: backup grant drift
mutate: grant execute on function sefirot.chat_complete_before_probe_fence(uuid,boolean,jsonb,text) to service_role

name: probe RPC grant drift
mutate: grant execute on function public.sefirot_probe_complete(uuid,integer,boolean,jsonb,text) to public

name: unexpected default function grant in public
mutate: create role rollout_unexpected; alter default privileges for role postgres in schema public grant execute on functions to rollout_unexpected

name: unexpected default function grant in sefirot
mutate: create role rollout_unexpected; alter default privileges for role postgres in schema sefirot grant execute on functions to rollout_unexpected
